sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to Alsager Town on Saturday for a match against one of the division's struggling sides. Sandbach are currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, though they've experienced a recent blip with a loss in their last outing. Alsager Town sit bottom with just 4 points and are winless in their last five matches, making this a golden opportunity for Sandbach to bounce back.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host Dawley Town in an important clash that could see them move closer to leaders Sandbach if they secure victory. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table, face Eccleshall at home—both teams have shown recent improvement and this will be a competitive fixture. Wolverhampton Casuals, sitting fourth, travel to Wednesfield Community on Saturday before facing Brereton Social in a midweek encounter on Wednesday. Bilston Town entertain Foley Meir in a mid-table clash, while Barnton host Shawbury United; the latter are struggling with a run of six consecutive losses and will need an upturn in form. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town in a fixture between teams fighting for mid-table security. Crewe host Allscott Heath, and Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town—both bottom-half contests where points are vital. Widnes Town, pointless so far, face an uphill task away at Brereton Social on Saturday.
